name: mem-enhance
description: One session with a plain message; on the Memory page (Project) enhancement is turned on and the Revisions section is open while Run now runs the three tasks for today (TASTE adds one entry with the session as evidence, STRATEGY and REVIEW change nothing). Run now again: nothing new, all three are skipped. The settings dialog then picks fake-coder-404, another message is sent and Run now fails all three (HTTP 404).
notes: Setup (synthetic test setup, docs/specs/memory.md §14.1): model-config.json has one local provider MEM (fake-coder; fake-think marked Supports thinking; fake-coder-404) on the synthetic endpoint http://127.0.0.1:4770/v1, default range mem/fake-coder, profiles given as verified; enhancement replies come from the synthetic enhancement script (FAKE_ENHANCE_SCRIPT)
